## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A short single-*juan* late-Míng letter (*shū* 書) by the Tiāntái monk **Kèqín** 克勤, abbot of the **Wǎguān jiàosì** 瓦官教寺 in Jiànkāng (Nánjīng), addressed to the Japanese Tendai abbot at Hieizan (the **Yánlìsì** 延曆寺 / Enryaku-ji). The letter is dated only to *jiǔyuè yīrì* 九月一日 ("9th month, 1st day") with the year unspecified. Body attribution: *Míng sēng Kèqín shū* 明僧克勤書.

**Abstract**

The letter narrates the institutional history of the Tiāntái-Tendai tradition from Zhìyǐ through the Tang transmission to Japan (via [最澄](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%9C%80%E6%BE%84) Saichō and [道邃](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%81%93%E9%82%83) Dàosuì) through the late-Tang persecution and the Sòng recovery. The work is one of the principal late-Míng documents of the Sino-Japanese Tendai institutional dialogue.

The text references *Xīngdào zūnzhě* ([道邃](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%81%93%E9%82%83) Dàosuì, the tenth Tiāntái patriarch and Saichō's teacher), the *Rìběn chuánjiào dàshī* ([最澄](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%9C%80%E6%BE%84) Saichō), and the late-Tang collapse-and-recovery period — providing valuable late-Míng documentation of the Sino-Japanese Tendai institutional self-understanding.

The composition is bracketed within the Míng productive period (1368–1644).
